checks.name: PRIMARY_SOURCE_EVIDENCE_MATRIX
checks.evidence: All four exact access-proven manuscripts exposed matching full bodies, methods and findings. Jasiak and Zhong rely on rolling FPCA and a KL dynamic-factor forecast; Hudson and Urquhart study a large technical-rule family with multiple-testing controls and report no Bitcoin out-of-sample predictability; Paskaleva and Vasenska compare fitted ML and deep-learning models with regime-transition degradation; Omole and Enke rely on feature selection and fitted deep-learning comparisons. None supplies one fixed low-complexity causal state.
